title: The cicada mark
note: Fires wherever the stencil turns up (ideas/entries/cicada-motif.json). Deliberately NOT a sting and NOT a music swap -- both would read as 'something ominous', which is not what this is yet, and a music swap would need somewhere to swap back to that this cue has no way of knowing (it fires from two different scenes with two different base soundscapes). Instead: a real cicada drone slips quietly into whatever ambience is already playing, easy to miss, and never announced. ost2-04-a-crystalline-night-sky is reserved for this motif for a later, more clearly-bounded scene -- not spent here.
